run_eval_discrete: run eval_discrete.py with an experiment root path to evaluate OT solver convergence errors
run_compute_errs: run the compute_errs function to compare Sinkhorn solver errors across zero, Gaussian, and Meta-OT initializations
run_profile_solvers: run the profile function to benchmark runtime of standard, Gaussian init, and Meta-OT Sinkhorn solvers
run_test_datasets: run eval_discrete.py with test data options like mnist, usps28, doodles, random, or world datasets
run_plot_convergence: run eval_discrete.py to generate a convergence error plot saved as errs.pdf for Sinkhorn iterations
